title: Zendaya Has a Ball Channeling Halle Berry for Halloween 2026
text:
Halloween 2026: Zendaya Channels Halle Berry in Vintage Set 
 E!'s The Golden Life
 Watch Episode 2 Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Zendaya Has a Ball Channeling Halle Berry for Halloween 2026
 Zendaya paid homage to Halle Berry on Halloween by recreating her iconic look from the 2000 premiere of X-Men . 
 By Sasha Wayman Oct 31, 2026 4:30 PM | Updated 59 minutes ago Tags Halloween Celebrities Zendaya Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Zendaya Makes Friendly Neighborhood Visit to Support Nephew EJ Coleman at Football Game Is Zendaya the greatest show woman? She certainly seems to be after her latest makeover.
 After all, the Euphoria alum channeled Halle Berry for Halloween 2026 by wearing the Catwoman star’s iconic two-piece ensemble from the early 2000s.
 “Zendaya channeling Halle Berry wearing @lanvin Fall 2000,” Zendaya’s stylist Law Roach captioned the look on Instagram Oct. 31 before shouting out members of the fashion house’s team. “Thank you @petercopping and @aliix_long.”
 The Challengers star served up style as she rocked the same Lanvin set that Berry wore to the New York premiere of X-Men in 2000. Not only did she rock the Monster’s Ball star’s unforgettable yellow and brown patchwork get-up—which was composed of low-rise pants and a bikini top—but Z also sported her iconic pixie cut, a look the 30-year-old debuted at the 2026 Emmys .
 Indeed, Zendaya first drew comparisons to Berry at the event when she stepped out on the red carpet donning her new ‘do, which she showed off in a bedazzled Prada gown. And the resemblance wasn’t lost on Berry either.
 read Why Law Roach Is Asking Fans to Let Zendaya “Live for a Second” “I love everything she’s doing,” Berry told People of the Disney Channel alum in September. “I think she is changing the game in so many ways for her generation. And I couldn’t be more proud of someone or to know someone honored that she would pay homage to me that way. That was really sweet.”
 And aside from Berry being a style muse for Zendaya, they have a personal connection as well.  
 Instagram/Law Roach “I do speak to her and I have to say she is the sweetest and my little sweetheart and I would love to find something to do with her someday,” the Crime 101 star shared. “I mean, hopefully we will, but I’m just a supporter of her.”
 Roach is also famously onboard the Zendaya train. And recently, he shared that even style icons need rest.
 "Zendaya is busy," Roach told E! News at the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on Oct. 18. "She's had a lot this year. Y'all, give my sister a break. Let her rest. Let her live for a second."
 Photo by Monica Schipper/Getty Images,Photo by Ke.Mazur/WireImage But fashion lovers need not worry. After all, Zendaya isn't done with her year of show-stopping looks just yet. That's because Dune: Part Three is set to hit theaters in December, meaning there’s much more where that came from.
 "She is preparing for the Dune three press tour, so am I," Roach continued. "So, she's resting."
